entities.name: Ulf
entities.description: A human researcher at the Tolarian Academy of Lat-Nam who strives to become a mage.

entities.name: Docent Thranegeld
entities.description: A dwarven artificer who tasked Ulf with a research project on Corondor and was murdered.

entities.name: Silas Brotten
entities.description: A docent who was a Phyrexian in disguise.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: A legendary planeswalker from Corondor's past who helped Ulf escape.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar
entities.description: The Demon King of Corondor whose curse the tome describes.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Evil beings who sought to control the world and hunted the tome.

events.summary: Docent Thranegeld tasks Ulf with a research project on Corondor; Ulf finds an ancient tome about the curse of Sol'Kanar, attracting Phyrexian attention.
events.quote: Ulf discovered an ancient, forgotten tome that detailed the curse of Sol'Kanar

events.summary: Ulf's roommates and Thranegeld are murdered.
events.quote: After Ulf's roommates and Thranegeld were murdered

events.summary: Ulf seeks help from Silas Brotten, who is a Phyrexian in disguise, and escapes with the book.
events.quote: who turned out to be a Phyrexian in disguise

events.summary: Jared Carthalion removes a tracking device from Ulf and urges him to escape with the book.
events.quote: Jared helped Ulf avoid capture by removing a tracking device
